summary: Implemented `py:type` and `:py:type:` using PyObject’s registration, qualification, and cross-reference behavior. Added optional canonical annotation rendering, module/class index text, documentation, release note, and regression tests for signatures, aliases, indexes, non-nesting, and role resolution. The focused suite passed: 20 tests; `git diff --check` passed. One unrelated LibreSSL warning appeared. I did not run the full test suite.
